title: Restriction of Zariski units along a closed immersion is an epimorphism
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. The canonical restriction $u_i:\mathcal O_X^\times\to i_*\mathcal O_Z^\times$ of [def-sc-zariski-units-restriction] is an epimorphism of abelian sheaves on the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site]: every local section of the target lifts after passage to an open covering.

source.place: Tag 09NY, varieties-lemma-lift-line-bundle-from-reduction-dimension-1, proof, opening short exact sequence; local lifting expanded explicitly

proof.text: At a point i(z), surjectivity of the local ring map lifts the germ of the prescribed unit. Since the ring map is local, the lift is a unit. Represent it on an open A inside the prescribed ambient open and restrict to its basic open B, obtaining an invertible representative. Equality of germs yields an open V in Z on which this representative maps to the prescribed unit.

Since i is a closed embedding, W = B minus i(Z minus V) is an ambient open neighbourhood of i(z) whose inverse image lies in V. Restrict the invertible representative to W. Naturality of the structure map and functoriality of restriction give the required equality. Off i(Z), use the complement of the closed image; its inverse image is empty, so the target units group is trivial. The local-surjectivity criterion for epimorphisms now concludes.
